counts={};nodes=0
for index,(row,ref,prior) in enumerate(zip(rows,refs,old,strict=True)):
    assert row['index']==index and row['family']==ref['family']
    assert row['reference_row_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(ref,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    board=chess.Board(row['root_fen'])
    for move in row['moves']:board.push_uci(move)
    assert board.fen()==ref['fen'] and row['moves']==ref['moves']
    legal={move.uci() for move in board.legal_moves};assert legal==set(ref['candidate_scores'])
    for name,arm in row['arms'].items():
        assert arm['selected'] in legal and sum(arm['visits'].values())==16
        assert set(arm['policy'])==legal and abs(sum(arm['policy'].values())-1)<1e-6
        assert arm['selected_expected_score']==ref['candidate_scores'][arm['selected']]['expected_score']
        expected=sum(p*ref['candidate_scores'][move]['expected_score'] for move,p in arm['policy'].items())
        assert abs(expected-arm['soft_expected_score'])<1e-12
        if name=='quiescent':
            q=arm['tactical_counts'];assert q['calls']==arm['nn_calls'] and q['calls']<=q['nodes']<=64*q['calls']
            for key,value in q.items():counts[key]=counts.get(key,0)+value
        else:assert not arm['tactical_counts']
    control=row['arms']['neural'];previous=prior['arms']['4']
    assert control['selected']==previous['selected'] and control['visits']==previous['visits'] and control['policy']==previous['policy']
    nodes+=sum(arm['nn_calls'] for arm in row['arms'].values())
assert nodes==result['nn_calls']<=7500 and counts==result['quiescent_counts']
for control,contrast in result['contrasts'].items():
    for endpoint,summary in contrast['endpoints'].items():
        family=[sum(row['arms']['quiescent'][endpoint]-row['arms'][control][endpoint] for row in rows if row['family']==f)/8 for f in range(16)]
        assert family==summary['family_effects'] and sum(family)/16==summary['mean']
        rng=random.Random(20261021);samples=sorted(sum(rng.choices(family,k=16))/16 for _ in range(10000))
        assert summary['conditional_bonferroni_four_contrast_98_75']==[samples[62],samples[9937]]
        assert summary['passed']==(summary['mean']>=.01 and samples[62]>0)
    assert contrast['qualified']==all(e['passed'] for e in contrast['endpoints'].values())
ratio=statistics.median(row['arms']['quiescent']['wall_seconds']/row['arms']['neural']['wall_seconds'] for row in rows)
assert ratio==result['median_paired_search_wall_ratio'] and result['wall_seconds']<=300
assert result['mechanism_gate_passed']==(all(c['qualified'] for c in result['contrasts'].values()) and ratio<=1.5 and counts['checked_fallback_calls']/counts['calls']<=.05)
receipt={'status':'pass','positions':128,'all_legal_reference_moves':sum(len(r['candidate_scores']) for r in refs),'nn_calls':nodes,'qcounts':counts,'historical_neural_control_exact':True,'four_adjusted_contrasts_recomputed':True,'source_commit':result['source_commit'],'scope':'Exact control reproduction is not independent evidence; classical material/search is not learned model gain.'}

try:

            order=['neural','static','quiescent'];order=order[index%3:]+order[:index%3];arms={}

                search=FullGumbelMCTS(evaluators[arm],rules=rules,config=FullGumbelConfig(simulations=16,max_considered_actions=4,gumbel_scale=0))

                policy={m.uci:p for m,p in r.action_weights};assert all(math.isfinite(p) and p>=0 for p in policy.values()) and abs(sum(policy.values())-1)<1e-6

            item={'index':index,'family':row['family'],'root_fen':row['root_fen'],'moves':row['moves'],'reference_row_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),'arms':arms};rows.append(item);stream.write(json.dumps(item)+'\n');stream.flush()

        passed=all(value['passed'] for value in values.values());contrasts[control]={'endpoints':values,'qualified':passed}

No new teacher calls or gradients; classical material is not learned.'}
